thresholds._comment: All signal thresholds live here. Edit and push; the daily workflow (or a manual run) recomputes signals.json and the dashboard.
thresholds._assets_comment: Companies tracked. The page, recommendation, analytics and backtest loop over this list. Adding a third company also needs a holdings/share-count + capital adapter in scripts/update_data.py and scripts/capital.py (BTC held, shares, debt, preferred, cash). The rotation spread uses the first two.

recommendation._comment: Single call per day. Flywheel ON for the call = code RUNNING_HOT or ON (the preferred CLOSED >= peg.on_close_threshold and has not since spent > peg.off_minutes_below market minutes below peg.on_trade_threshold; WARMING_UP is off). MSTR is also not on while buyback_support is flagged. Parent all-in mNAV overheated (per-stock floor AND overheated_percentile, on overheat_basis) is a filter; if both flywheels are on and neither overheated, an unusual rotation z picks the cheaper one, a normal z gives BUY_BOTH. Otherwise STAY_BTC (displayed as WAIT).

peg._comment: Flywheel rule (review applied 2026-10-28). Turns ON only on a completed daily CLOSE >= on_close_threshold for that preferred (STRC $100.00, SATA $99.80); an intraday touch never turns it on, and before the 4 PM ET close the call uses the last completed close. Once ON it stays ON until it trades below on_trade_threshold for MORE THAN off_minutes_below consecutive regular-session minutes (overnight/weekend gaps don't count). Labels: RUNNING_HOT (on, price >= running_hot.price_min AND heavy volume) > ON ('FLYWHEEL ON') > WARMING_UP (OFF for the call / watch only: traded >= on_trade_threshold without a qualifying close; STRC closes $99.80-$99.99 too) > COOLING_OFF (off, price >= stalled_below) > STALLED (off, below stalled_below). Older history with daily bars only: ON at a qualifying close; OFF at a close < on_trade_threshold; a day whose high touched on_trade_threshold but closed below the close threshold is WARMING_UP (off). full_on_threshold is now display-only (share of closes at/above it). See scripts/flywheel.py.

on_close_threshold._comment: Daily CLOSE needed to turn the flywheel ON, per preferred (review change 1).

running_hot._comment: Heavy volume at/above par: on AND latest price >= price_min AND volume >= vol_mult_min x the prior vol_avg_days trading-day average (today: pace = volume so far / fraction of the session elapsed) AND, when intraday bars exist, >= min_share_at_or_above of the day's volume traded at >= price_min.

atm._comment: Bobby's rule (2026-11-04): a day where the issuer actively sold the preferred through its ATM (data/atm_activity.json, shares_sold > 0) with intraday high >= min_high and close >= min_close counts like a qualifying close: promotes to at least FLYWHEEL ON. That ON then persists under the usual off rules (more than off_minutes_below minutes below on_trade_threshold, or a daily-approx close below it); a later day with no ATM row that closes slightly under $100 does not drop it to WARMING_UP. STRC ATM sales also turn the buyback flag OFF and keep it off until a later 8-K week (ending after that ATM date) shows buybacks with no sales. Price-close rule remains the fallback when no ATM data exists.

mnav._overheated_comment: Overheated floor is per stock per date: base = that stock's cheap CAP (valuation.cheap_cap; MSTR held flat at 1.10x until its own 1y median mNAV > 1.30x, ASST on the rising schedule) + overheated_gap_above_cheap, + overheated_bonus_on while its flywheel is ON (code ON), + overheated_bonus_running_hot while RUNNING_HOT (not WARMING_UP). Overheated = mNAV >= floor AND >= overheated_percentile of the lookback. overheated_min_mnav is the legacy fixed floor, kept only as a fallback.
mnav._both_overheated_comment: when MSTR and ASST are both overheated, the legacy per-asset action is sell / trim both and no buy right now (overrides flywheel-driven parent actions); the main call shows WAIT
mnav._signal_basis_comment: Which mNAV drives overheated / rotation / dip / zones: 'ev' (all-in: equity at basic shares + debt + preferred notional - cash, over BTC NAV), 'basic' (market-standard: price x basic shares / BTC NAV) or 'diluted' (price x assumed-diluted shares / BTC NAV).
mnav._ev_share_basis_comment: Share count used for the equity leg of EV. 'basic' (Strategy's own EV definition) avoids double-counting convertible notes, which are already in debt. 'diluted' is an option.

valuation._comment: Zones (review change 4), applied to each mNAV basis separately using each stock's own trailing mnav.lookback_trading_days (252) percentile on that basis: OVERVALUED: mNAV >= the stock's overheated floor OR percentile >= mnav.overheated_percentile (90th). CHEAP: percentile <= cheap_max_percentile (25th) AND mNAV <= the stock's cheap cap. FAIR: percentile <= rich_above_percentile (75th) (incl. bottom-quartile days above the cap). RICH: above the 75th percentile, below OVERVALUED.

cheap_below_mnav_schedule._comment: Bull-cycle cheap line: start at start_date, rising linearly to end at end_date (next BTC halving estimate; update when known), flat at end afterwards. Dates before start_date use the flat start value (1.10x).

cheap_cap._comment: The bull-cycle line (cheap_below_mnav_schedule) is a CAP: never CHEAP above it. Per stock: 'schedule' follows it; 'hold_until_median' stays flat at hold_value until the stock's own trailing-1y median mNAV (signal basis) is above median_above, then follows the schedule.

dip._comment: Dip = BTC down >= btc_drop_pct over the last lookback_days trading days. Target = whichever of MSTR/ASST had the larger % drop in mNAV (mnav.signal_basis) over the same window (got cheaper vs its own bitcoin); tie (within tie_tolerance) broken by the larger price drop.

big_moves._comment: absolute daily close-to-close % move that counts as a Big Move

capital._comment: Inputs for the all-in (EV) mNAV. Debt, preferred and cash timelines are built automatically from SEC filings + Strategy's KPI API (scripts/capital.py, data/capital_events.json); nothing here is a hand-typed balance.

odds_jumps._comment: Odds Jumps module: flag tracked prediction markets whose Yes probability moved >= jump_24h_pts in one day or >= jump_7d_pts over 7 days, within the last window_days.

buy_flags._comment: Display flags (do not change the recommendation). flywheel_cheap: the parent's flywheel ON (its preferred, an indicator not a trade, code ON or RUNNING_HOT, not held by buybacks) AND parent all-in mNAV zone CHEAP, or FAIR with 1y percentile < low_fair_max_percentile ('low-FAIR'). very_low_mnav (secondary cue for the parent): all-in mNAV <= very_low_max_mnav OR 1y percentile <= very_low_max_percentile, shown even when the parent's flywheel is only cooling off near par.

buyback_support._comment: Par held up by buybacks (review change 3). From the latest Strategy weekly 8-K table: if the latest reported week shows STRC buybacks > 0 and STRC ATM sales = 0 the flag turns on; it stays on until a later 8-K shows STRC sales again. A STRC ATM day in data/atm_activity.json (shares_sold > 0) dated after that week's end clears the flag and keeps it off until a newer 8-K week ending after the ATM date shows buybacks with no sales. While on, MSTR's flywheel does NOT count as on for the call (STRC may still show ON). If the 8-K parse fails, the last known value is kept (data/strc_buyback_state.json) with its date.

sats_context._comment: SATS context chip near SATA (review change 5). Display only, never a trigger.

thresholds._refresh_trigger_comment: Optional URL of a proxy (see workers/refresh-trigger) that starts update.yml. Empty = Refresh opens the GitHub Run workflow page and polls. Never put a token here.
